mode: Built-in image_gen editing, referenced approved night-market gameplay image

prompts.prompt: Edit this approved night-market gameplay artwork into a CLEAN EMPTY GAME BACKGROUND usable as an actual game texture. Preserve warm hand-painted cartoon 2D style, gray blue flat stone plaza, outer-edge market stalls, lanterns, umbrellas, crates and little warm pools of light. REMOVE ALL characters, bun monsters, noodle monsters, takeout monsters, pickup bubbles, skateboards, fan, soda, particles, rings, effects, HUD, score, timer, pause button, joystick, bottom status plaque and ALL TEXT. Nothing should remain in the center except understated open stone pavement. Extend pavement naturally where characters stood. Full top-down 3/4 orthographic game arena, landscape 16:9, no UI. Decorative stalls stay within outer 6-9% perimeter, center 85% almost entirely unobstructed and low contrast for gameplay; the top outer edge can have stalls. Keep full scene sharp, no vignette darkening over playfield. This is a production game level background, not a screenshot with frozen characters. No sprites or text anywhere.

Use the provided screenshot ONLY as character design and art style reference. Generate a PRODUCTION 2D GAME SPRITE ATLAS on a GENUINELY TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND (alpha), no checkerboard illustration, no solid background. Wide 2:1 aspect ratio. Exactly FOUR COLUMNS and TWO ROWS of EIGHT equal rectangular cells. Every sprite centered within its cell with at least 15% transparent padding on all sides, no overlapping cell boundary, no borders, no labels, no text. Each cell contains exactly ONE complete isolated sprite (no shadow, no effects, no glow, no pickup bubbles). Consistent hand-painted cartoon dark-brown outlines and soft cel shading, 3/4 game sprite view, all facing right where applicable. Ensure logical uniform grid locations so code can draw each cell separately.
CELL ORDER strictly row-major:
top row col1: the approved adult female courier orange helmet/orange jacket/teal satchel/dark ponytail/white sneakers, full body RUN POSE A: front leg extended forward, back leg behind, cheeky determined face.
top row col2: EXACT SAME courier identity proportions, RUN POSE B opposite legs and arm swing, same orientation facing right, same framing and scale as pose A.
top row col3: ONE small steamed-bun goblin with dough crimped top, expressive angry face, little arms and running feet.
top row col4: ONE red takeout-box mimic, hinged lid, noodle hair, grumpy eyes, visible little running legs.
bottom row col1: ONE wide soup-noodle-bowl monster, white ceramic bowl, green noodle tendrils, expressive face, short feet.
bottom row col2: ONE turquoise retro tabletop electric fan, recognisable blades, grille and stand.
bottom row col3: ONE red skateboard, white stripe, black wheels, complete in 3/4 view.
bottom row col4: ONE green glass soda bottle, lemon label, cream cap.
People/monsters fill ~70% cell height, props ~60%. No tiny extra sprites, faces detached, loose parts, props outside cell, frame lines or shadows. This is an asset sheet to be drawn with sprite coordinates. Transparent background REQUIRED. Match the approved person's recognizable features; not geometric symbols.
